## CHAT FRONT FOR THE S1 DEMO

Same engine as **System 1 (Laya) Ticket Triage** - identical ollaya call and identical routing rules - but tickets arrive as chat messages and the decision posts back into the chat.

TO RUN:
1. ACTIVATE this workflow (hosted chat only listens when active).
2. Open http://localhost:5678/webhook/system1-triage-chat/chat in a browser tab.
3. Paste a ticket (the 4 demo tickets are pre-filled in the chat's initial message).

Fallback: point the ONE URL field in **Laya Decide (System 1)** at the canned responder (see fallback/README.md) and the chat demo works with no live model.
